data.title: Block out a traversable cave
data.summary: Three chambers linked by a 2 m minimum passage. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: Modifiers change evaluated geometry through an editable operation stack.

prerequisites: An authorized Blender Geometry Nodes environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: Three chambers linked by a 2 m minimum passage.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent cave blockout workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: Three chambers linked by a 2 m minimum passage. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Place simple chamber volumes and connect them with broad passage forms

data.prompt: Help me block out a traversable cave in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: Three chambers linked by a 2 m minimum passage. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: The narrowest passage clears the intended player envelope; No isolated interior surface blocks the route. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
